name: web-fashion-listing-page-desktop-and-mobile-over-silhouette
title: Hoodie listing pages with filter column, 4-up grid and cropped footer wordmark over a dark silhouette
whatItIs: A dark gradient board with an uppercase intro sentence and two white pages: a desktop listing with a collapsible filter column, a four-column grid of models in hoodies with names and prices, pagination, and black footer with a cropped giant wordmark; and a two-column mobile version.
whatItMeans: Orderly and dependable; even spacing and consistent photography make 40 items scannable.
techniques: Use identical model photo cropping across the grid.
Keep a collapsible filter column at left.
Cut the footer wordmark by the edge.

vocabulary.definition: Evenly spaced product cards in columns.
A side list of collapsible filters.
Numbered controls for pages of results.
